C08-M09-L02-F1.title: Triage a link or attachment from evidence
C08-M09-L02-F1.caption: Static observations and activity evidence support separate containment and analysis decisions.
C08-M09-L02-F1.alt: The workflow starts by preserving the original report. A static record captures the link or attachment. The analyst compares the object with trusted context and checks separately for user or system activity. The decision is routed to the authorised owner and the evidence and next action go into the case.

steps.label: Route the next decision
steps.sub: Preserve the rationale and assign an owner

C08-M09-L02-F1.note: Maintain separate findings about the object and its effects.
